## Disposition

Accept scoped partial results for algebraic dimension from a positive normal bundle, with the complete independent audit and correction patch. The general implication remains unresolved after 5/5 approaches. No sixth route, general proof, target counterexample, novelty claim or worldwide-openness certificate is added.

The finite-Taylor lemma gives generic local full-rank separation on a connected manifold under joint point separation. It does not assert globally finite fibres or extension to a compact parameter space. The conditional boundary bridge retains normality, an effective Cartier divisor, algebraically independent holomorphic complement functions and locally polynomial boundary growth. The proper generically finite field bridge starts with whole-space meromorphic functions, using normalization and Stein factorization; it does not remove essential boundary singularities from arbitrary complement functions. Finite incidence and local separation remain source hypotheses, the residual case remains open here, and the Peternell p=2 result retains compact Kahler ambient space. All examples obstruct intermediate shortcuts rather than refuting the target.

## Current mathematics and fresh verification

All 19 accepted inputs are byte-preserved under current/, including the corrected report, all five companion proofs, full authored audit, correction patch, original checker, independent checker and historical public verification metadata. Source documents/text, datasets, private sources, private coordination and identifying metadata for excluded private material are excluded. The source titles, public URLs, hashes, sizes and retrieval/inspection history describe historical public evidence. No new source-body or literature replay is claimed.

Each independent suite performs exactly 2,445 checks per mode: 2,433 finite mathematical checks, eight documentary/scope guards and four environment checks. Original CLI modes report 600 exact, 12 negative and 612 combined checks. Three positive CLI suites and three intentionally injected failures per interpreter mode are checked separately, plus the exact invalid-CLI rejection. Twenty-two semantic mutants are rejected at their intended condition: 14 finite-mathematics mutations and eight documentary/scope guards. Finite computation does not prove analytic source theorems, the infinite Laurent tail, or the unresolved global implication.

Normal, -O and -OO are freshly replayed with actual UID=EUID=1000, -I -S -B, 0444 files and 0555 directories. Every mode-specific stdout/stderr byte and recursive JSON type is compared without normalization. Exact positive/control identities and counts exclude empty, skipped or expected-failure success. Changed details, extra output, nested bool/int substitution, wrong optimization mode, unexpected stderr and hostile imports are rejected or isolated as appropriate.

Each mode records 58 whole-packet physical EACCES denials plus two semantic-harness input denials, 73 integrity negatives, 69 schema/scope negatives and 57 exact-comparator negatives. The full hostile-environment output matches the clean baseline and the startup/import sentinel remains absent. Whole-packet before/after hashes are identical.

The tested runtime is CPython 3.12.14 with standard library only. The interpreter/standard library are trusted, not authenticated here. Unix read-only permissions are an accidental-write barrier, not kernel immutability or protection against intentional owner chmod.

The external bootstrap authenticates the full recursive inventory, including acceptance, every historical receipt, mode-specific references and pre-seal receipts. Final external receipts remain outside that inventory to avoid circular self-hashing. NOT_RUN: excluded original-report replay, historical audit-harness replay, historical correction-patch application, source-body replay, new source search, dataset replay and formal proof-assistant verification. current/run_audit.py is preserved but its old harness is not the fresh publication runner.

## Scope and independent trust pins

This draft adds exactly 56 files (631,527 bytes) under unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30000012. No QUEUE or unrelated changes. Base commit: 6ca1e663ab556636a3c2a9b67a96274ef95e8bab. Base tree: a675bbb4eb340ad8a83943d490404c5f9585c0e1. Branch: audit/positive-normal-dimension-30000012-partial.

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py against this independent SHA-256 before execution, retain that copy outside the packet, and run it with -I -S -B, optionally -O/-OO, plus --controls and the packet directory. No private source or accepted-audit archive is required.
